learner_operation: Identify independent h(x) and g(y) in the ODE, then select an equivalent equation (1/g(y))dy/dx=h(x). Merely recognizing a distinctive answer-row shape does not perform that operation.

fixed_features.feature: First-order dy/dx, separated y-only multiplier and x-only RHS; no integration.
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 6767 explicitly defines this target form; canonical example stops at this step.

fixed_features.feature: Single radio field and five complete equations.
fixed_features.justification: All ten captured source question banks use this response contract.

fixed_features.feature: Bounded positive coefficients and even positive-polynomial/radical powers.
fixed_features.justification: Keep real regular domains and the same local algebra; broad sign coverage is not necessary to demonstrate reciprocal transfer.

answer_roles.role: Correct complete equation and its display position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Derive the reciprocal factor and x-only RHS from each new instance; shuffle rows.
answer_roles.observed: Correct expressions update with parameters; native grading accepts them. Raw sampler and UI shuffle row positions.

answer_roles.role: Dependent factor in numerator versus denominator
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Both direct and reciprocal multipliers are supported by easy sources q-158022 and q-158025/q-158030; vary factor/power roles without adding integration.
answer_roles.observed: Both operation types occur across easy templates, before and after delivery; quotient templates always isolate the correct response as the sole fractionless row.

answer_roles.role: Fraction-bar layout of correct versus incorrect choices
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Use same-scope distractors and bank profiles so a fractionless row can be incorrect and the correct row need not be uniquely recognizable without reading the ODE. Preserve observed banks for source replay.
answer_roles.observed: exp_quotient and simple_quotient fix four fractional distractors against one fractionless correct response for every allowed parameter, by construction.

coverage.case: Six easy template profiles before/after filtering
coverage.result: 18 inputs ->15 accepted; all six profiles survive; direct multiplication and reciprocal division both remain.
5->5 accepted; four recognizable templates, including one exp_quotient item vulnerable to prompt-blind fraction-bar selection. This is not a claim that a single cue solves all five.

coverage.case: Independent quotient seed cases and minimal boundary
coverage.result: 13/13 prompt-blind selections correct across fresh seeds 27011..27016 and minimal n=1,seed=17; shuffles and numerical variation do not remove the cue.

counterfactuals.change: Hold rational_product a=2 and seed=8102; change n=2 to n=3.
counterfactuals.expected: ODE changes from xy^2/(x+2) to xy^3/(x+2); correct multiplier and worked explanation change from 1/y^2 to 1/y^3; the direct-multiplier distractor remains rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt/key/solution update as expected; native grader accepts the appropriate key and rejects all alternatives; screenshots 006/007 show corresponding math.
counterfactuals.justification: The dependent exponent controls which reciprocal factor is needed, per source q-154678 and tutorial 6767.

counterfactuals.change: Hold rational_product parameters n=2,a=2; seed=8102 ->8103 changes only option order.
counterfactuals.expected: Same mathematical prompt, correct expression and explanation; correct choice ID continues to be accepted despite different order.
counterfactuals.observed: All content/key invariants preserved; row order changes. Native grader passes and screenshots 006/008 show preserved mathematics.
counterfactuals.justification: Order is absent from the source definition of separated variables and cannot determine correctness.

stages_examined: Generator parameter validation and difficulty eligibility; no rejection/resampling loop
Actual publication normalization, stable identities, captured inventory and batch deduplication
Actual learner selection algorithm: history exclusion and weighted band/uniform within-band selection, conditional read-only simulation
Actual UI choice rendering and native ID-based grading
delivery.result: Cue survives filtering in 5/15 control and 1/5 batch records. Within any fresh eligible positive-weight easy pool these records remain selectable; selection does not rewrite banks. No personalized live state is claimed.

limitations: Finite audit, not proof against every shortcut.
Canonical radical has no captured answer bank and is not a supported replay family; no answer choices invented.
Captured inventory basis 5365; six generated records tested and this particular shortcut absent there. Original source instances with the cue are not reported as generated.
No supplied learner history, live policy weights, reservations, or future assigned entity IDs; conditional selection analysis uses actual code with explicitly labeled surrogate pools.

Raw first/last/TeX-length probes are retained; same-seed boundary samples and UI reordering prevent interpreting their conditional counts as a delivered position defect. The fractionless cue is independently confirmed visually.
